sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1021343', '3008316085', '1925262', '2220077', '1028892') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('hospira', 'pfizer india', 'b braun', 'avantor performance materials', 'liebel flarsheim')) ORDER BY date_published
